payload.title: File:Baryonyx by durbed.jpg
payload.description_html: A spinosaurid sunbathes while the pterosaur Europejara and bird Iberomesornis groom it for parasites and bits of meat. While the spinosaur was originally identified as Baryonyx walkeri, it has since been determined that this genus is not present in the Iberian spinosaur fossil record.
